flyweight.name: Flyweight
flyweight.description: Lightning-fast fighters who dance across the canvas like ghosts — what they lack in brute force, they make up for in precision and flair.

bantamweight.name: Bantamweight
bantamweight.description: Smart, sharp, and strategic. Every jab’s a brushstroke — these fighters win with rhythm, timing, and brains over brawn.

featherweight.name: Featherweight
featherweight.description: All about balance — fast hands, sharp minds, and enough pop in their punches to make the crowd gasp.

welterweight.name: Welterweight
welterweight.description: The heart of the Federation — strong, agile, and adaptable. Every match here feels like a main event.

middleweight.name: Middleweight
middleweight.description: Calculated aggression and perfect form. These are the tacticians — they hit hard but never lose control.

heavyweight.name: Heavyweight
heavyweight.description: When these giants swing, the air itself flinches. Every punch is a sermon — every knockout, a revelation.
